The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 80d721e72d29a9bc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 78-79. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. statement: Fix the coefficient prime p and the defect-order bound M. For the comparison data of Definition 8.4, let S ≤ Y0 be a p-subgroup contained in the pure X-actions. There is a positive integer m, bounded in terms of p and M, and a Morita bimodule M : ON̄σm (b̄)-ON̄b̄ such that its reduction M0 = k ⊗O M has invertible k-linear maps Jx, for x ∈ S, with J1 = id, satisfying Jx(avb) = α′ x(a)Jx(v)αx(b), (9.1) Jx Jy(v) = a′ xy Jxy(v)a−1 xy . (9.2) 78 Here αx is the action of the chosen representative hx, α′ x = σm(αx), axy = nxyb̄, and a′ xy = nxyσm(b̄) = σm(axy). The assertion includes S = 1. The bound does not depend on the orders of the universal-cover kernels or of the added central tori.
